name: loom-optimize
description: Use when the user says "optimize my loom namespace", "audit memory", "my memory search is bad", "loom keeps abstaining", or asks why recall over a namespace their agent writes to does not work, or when the mentor's `documents_as_memories` / `checkpoints_as_memory` / `records_for_identities` hint names rows to rework. Runs `namespace.audit`, turns each finding into a plan the owner approves, and reworks the rows with `memory.move` so every old key stays readable through a redirect. Retires nothing. NOT for deciding what to write in the first place (loom-memory) and NOT for client-side failures (loom-status).
